color.desc: Color name for component from the Quasar Color Palette

text-color.desc: Overrides text color (if needed); Color name from the Quasar Color Palette

size.desc: Size in CSS units, including unit name

dark.desc: Notify the component that the background is a dark color

icon.desc: Icon name following Quasar convention; Make sure you have the icon library installed unless you are using 'img:' prefix; If 'none' (String) is used as value then no icon is rendered (but screen real estate will still be used for it)

bordered.desc: Applies a default border to the component

square.desc: Removes border-radius so borders are squared

rounded.desc: Applies a small standard border-radius for a squared shape of the component

model-value.desc: Model of the component; Either use this property (along with a listener for 'update:model-value' event) OR use v-model directive

html.desc: Force use of textContent instead of innerHTML to render text; Use it when the text might be unsafe (from user input)

scroll-target.desc: CSS selector or DOM element to be used as a custom scroll container instead of the auto detected one

ripple.desc: Configure material ripple (disable it by setting it to 'false' or supply a config object)
examples: { early: true, center: true, color: 'teal', keyCodes: [] }

option-value.desc: Property of option which holds the 'value'; If using a function then for best performance, reference it from your scope and do not define it inline

option-label.desc: Property of option which holds the 'label'; If using a function then for best performance, reference it from your scope and do not define it inline

option-disable.desc: Property of option which tells it's disabled; The value of the property must be a Boolean; If using a function then for best performance, reference it from your scope and do not define it inline

returns.desc: If true, the current option will be disabled

input-class.desc: Class definitions to be attributed to the underlying input tag

input-style.desc: Style definitions to be attributed to the underlying input tag

maxlength.desc: Specify a max length of model

table-separator.desc: Use a separator/border between rows, columns or all cells

content-class.desc: Class definitions to be attributed to the content wrapper

tab-no-caps.desc: Turns off capitalizing all letters within the tab (which is the default)

default.desc: Default slot in the devland unslotted content of the component

update:model-value.desc: Emitted when the component needs to change the model; Is also used by v-model

show.desc: Emitted after component has triggered show()

before-show.desc: Emitted when component triggers show() but before it finishes doing it

after-show.desc: Emitted when component show animation is finished

hide.desc: Emitted after component has triggered hide()

before-hide.desc: Emitted when component triggers hide() but before it finishes doing it

after-hide.desc: Emitted when component hide animation is finished

click.desc: Emitted when user clicks/taps on the component

navigation-click.desc: Emitted when the component is clicked

evt.desc: JS event object; If you are using route navigation ('to'/'replace' props) and you want to cancel navigation then call evt.preventDefault() synchronously in your event handler

go.desc: Available ONLY if you are using route navigation ('to'/'replace' props); When you need to control the time at which the component should trigger the route navigation then call evt.preventDefault() synchronously and then call this function at your convenience; Useful if you have async work to be done before the actual route navigation or if you want to redirect somewhere else

to.desc: Equivalent to Vue Router <router-link> 'to' property; Specify it explicitly otherwise it will be set with same value as component's 'to' prop

replace.desc: Equivalent to Vue Router <router-link> 'replace' property; Specify it explicitly otherwise it will be set with same value as component's 'replace' prop

returnRouterError.desc: Return the router error, if any; Otherwise the returned Promise will always fulfill

toggle.desc: Triggers component to toggle between show/hide

updateScrollTarget.desc: Updates the scroll target; Useful when the parent elements change so that the scrolling target also changes
